payload.verify_command: id=$(gh run list --workflow ci.yml --limit 20 --json databaseId,headBranch,event,headSha --jq '[.[] | select(.headBranch=="phase/mypy-gate" and .event=="pull_request" and .headSha=="'"$(git rev-parse phase/mypy-gate)"'")][0].databaseId') && gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/$id/jobs --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name=="types") | .conclusion' | grep -qx success
